scenes.title: HugeGraph PD
scenes.spoken: This is Huge Graph P D, the Placement Driver: the control plane of a distributed Huge Graph cluster.
scenes.caption: This is HugeGraph PD, the Placement Driver: the control plane of a distributed HugeGraph cluster.

scenes.title: Three roles
scenes.spoken: Servers run graph queries. Stores hold the graph data. P D holds only the metadata: which stores are alive, and where every partition lives.
scenes.caption: Servers run graph queries. Stores hold the graph data. PD holds only the metadata: which stores are alive, and where every partition lives.

scenes.title: Partitions
scenes.spoken: Every key hashes to a sixteen-bit code. P D splits that range into partitions, and places each partition's replicas on different stores, one as the leader.
scenes.caption: Every key hashes to a 16-bit code. PD splits that range into partitions, and places each partition's replicas on different stores, one as the leader.

scenes.title: Heartbeats
scenes.spoken: Stores register with P D and send heartbeats. P D answers with instructions: move a partition, split it, or transfer its leader. A store that goes quiet is marked offline.
scenes.caption: Stores register with PD and send heartbeats. PD answers with instructions: move a partition, split it, or transfer its leader. A store that goes quiet is marked offline.

scenes.title: Raft
scenes.spoken: P D itself runs as three or five nodes on Sofa J Raft. Every metadata write is a Raft proposal, saved in Rocks D B. If the leader fails, the others elect a new one.
scenes.caption: PD itself runs as three or five nodes on SOFA-JRaft. Every metadata write is a Raft proposal, saved in RocksDB. If the leader fails, the others elect a new one.

scenes.title: Routing
scenes.spoken: Servers ask P D where a key lives, cache the answer, and talk to that store directly. P D stays out of the data path.
scenes.caption: Servers ask PD where a key lives, cache the answer, and talk to that store directly. PD stays out of the data path.
